metadata.title: Clicked like I lost my brain and somehow landed 1 accidental kill? Valorant logic broke again
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing like this kill’s a glitch
Enemy: probably asking ‘Wait, what just happened?’
How did I even hit that? Still don’t know, but I’ll take it

Tap if your worst clicks ever surprise even YOU!
